entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah, VeloFit agent ID 303. How can I help you today?
Hi, Sarah. I... I need to return something. It's a VeloBand GPS Tracker. I just... I don't think I can keep it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and the order number?
Yes, it's David Miller, and the order number is VF88612. I've been a loyal customer for years, I just... I really needed this money back.

Thank you, David. I see the order right here. Just to make sure I'm helping in the best way possible, can I ask what the issue is? Is it a technical fault with the band, or more of a personal preference?
Oh, no, it works fine. It's a great product. It's just... things are a bit tight right now, and it was more of an impulse buy. I feel pretty bad about it, honestly.
I understand completely. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. I see here that the VeloBand was delivered on December 15th, which was 26 days ago.
Oh... is that a problem? I was so busy over the holidays, I didn't even get a chance to think about it. I was really hoping you could help me out.
Not a problem at all, David. According to our policy, for the standard VeloBand GPS Tracker, you have 90 days from the date of delivery to make a return. You are well within that window.
Really? Oh, thank goodness! That is such a relief. I was so worried. Thank you, Sarah!

Of course. I'm happy to help. I've just initiated the return process for you and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. Just pack the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, you'll see a full refund within 3-5 business days.
That is fantastic news. You've really made my day. Thank you so much for being so understanding.
You're very welcome, David. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that's everything. Thank you again!
Alright. Have a great day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
